title: Flatness of the Artinian finite étale lift
statement: For a flat local map D to S of local Artinian rings and a finite étale local Artinian D-algebra D' with a local map D' to S factoring D to S, the map D' to S is flat.

source.place: Tag 07FI, flatness of the last map; proof refined using Mathlib etale cancellation

proof.text: Use the factorization equality to define the S-algebra section sigma:S tensor_D D'→S, s tensor d ↦ s g'(d).

The inclusion D'→S tensor_D D' is flat by flat base change and the tensor commutativity equivalence (RingHom.flat_algebraMap_iff, the tensor-flatness instance, RingHom.Flat.of_bijective and RingHom.Flat.comp).

Etale base change makes the tensor algebra etale over S. The identity S→S is etale; Algebra.Etale.of_restrictScalars makes its section sigma etale. Algebra.Smooth.flat then makes sigma flat. These are direct Mathlib applications.
The composite of the inclusion with sigma is g'; RingHom.Flat.comp concludes.

proof_origin.place: Tag 07FI flatness assertion; shorter below-unit proof by Mathlib etale cancellation and flat base change

mathlib_searches.query: If A is flat over R and B is an etale R algebra acting on A then A is flat over B
mathlib_searches.results: Algebra.Etale.baseChange and Algebra.Etale.of_restrictScalars provide the shorter proof; no exact theorem.
Exact cancellation lemma, checked against source and used in proof.
Smooth.flat, flat tensor base change, RingHom.Flat.comp and Etale.of_restrictScalars suffice.

mathlib_searches.query: Flatness of an algebra over an etale extension when the composite is flat
